summary: Frontend-only regression + fresh signup e2e walkthrough (iteration 142). Tests 1-5 (fix re-checks on owner The Dev Store, read-only) all PASS. Test 6 (fresh signup walkthrough on 390x844 for a brand-new merchant qa_fresh_walkthrough_1789004088@example.com, user_id=182) completes end-to-end through all 4 wizard steps, with ONE observed defect: the fee-free-welcome modal on /dashboard did NOT navigate to /pay-links after its CTA was clicked (it correctly closed the modal but left the browser on /dashboard). Cleanup ran successfully; DONE printed by scratch_fresh_signup_cleanup.js.

ui_bugs.issue: After the wizard completes and the user lands on /dashboard, the 'You’re in!' fee-free modal DOES render with the correct CTA label 'Share your payment link' — but clicking [data-testid=fee-free-welcome-cta] closes the modal WITHOUT navigating to /pay-links. Waited 4s post-click; page.url remained /dashboard and the CTA element was gone. Spec expected the click to land on /pay-links.

action_items: Fix Components/Modals/FeeFreeWelcomeModal.tsx onCTA handler so clicking 'Share your payment link' both closes the modal AND router.push('/pay-links'). Currently it only closes.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'Add wallet' header button on /wallet has no data-testid. The spec mentions data-testid=wallet-add-btn (used by other flows on that page for icons). Adding it to the header Button in the /wallet page component would make the flow deterministic without relying on button text.

The notification preference testids exist for 6 controls but the names differ from what iteration_141 assumed. They are: notification-pref-transactionUpdates, notification-pref-paymentReceived, notification-pref-weeklySummary, notification-pref-securityAlerts, notification-pref-emailNotifications, notification-pref-smsNotifications. Good — stable contract. Not a bug.

MUI tabs on the notifications page don’t expose aria-selected on the [data-testid=notifications-settings-tab] element; consider forwarding aria-selected so screen readers and E2E can detect the active tab without relying on visible switches.

rca of the issue: Fee-free CTA navigation defect: The onClick handler in Components/Modals/FeeFreeWelcomeModal.tsx likely calls onClose() but forgets router.push('/pay-links') (or the two are wired sequentially and the modal unmount races with the navigation). Fix: on CTA click, call router.push('/pay-links') FIRST and then onClose() in a microtask, or move onClose to the router event callback. Also add e2e coverage that asserts URL becomes /pay-links AND the modal is not visible on the /pay-links page.
